tweets.text: 🇩🇪🇨🇳 Volkswagen is planning to cut up to 100,000 jobs worldwide and close four German plants in a major cost-cutting push to fight Chinese EV rivals and fix profitability. That’s roughly 1 in 6 of its 625,000 global workforce, one of the biggest corporate layoff programs ever. Unions are already vowing to fight it hard. This shows just how tough things are getting for legacy European carmakers right now. Europe waking up late to Chinese competition after handing over key industries for years. Source: Financial Times / Writer: Lucas

It's basically a proof of concept with an audience. Washington is demonstrating that it can move oil through the Strait regardless of what Iran says or does about it and doing so with enough firepower overhead to make the point impossible to miss. The corridor either holds or it doesn't and the whole world is watching this particular tanker find out. Source: @MenchOsint / Writer: Oliver
